purpose: Test whether the existing Hybrid Ridge text model adds complementary error information to the existing LightGBM SVD32 champion.
source_scope: Official Regression Train only; cycles 47-79. Official Test, labels from other tasks, external datasets, and Kaggle feedback are not used.
primary_control: lgb_text_inner_v1: LightGBM regression_l1 + structured + TF-IDF/SVD32, with its frozen past-only selected parameter and rank mapping.
secondary_control: hybrid_ridge_inner_v1: expanded structured + TF-IDF Ridge, with its frozen past-only selected rank mapping.
folds: The six frozen expanding primary windows and two H12 windows from experiments/regression_round2/protocol.json.
component_policy: At each cutoff, use each component's existing inner-selected model parameter and within-cycle rank weight. Blend the mapped component predictions; Ridge share is alpha.
inner_selection: At each outer cutoff E, choose Ridge share by pooled MAE on cycles E-3..E. Inner component predictions come from models fit only on cycles 47..E-4. Ties within 1e-10 choose the lower Ridge share, retaining more of the LightGBM champion.
outer_application: Apply the selected share to the already frozen component predictions from models fit on cycles 47..E, evaluated only on cycles after E.

computed_fit_budget.reason: Reuse historical cache artifacts only after validating their folds, model-state hashes, prediction hashes, code identity, and raw Train identity.
computed_fit_budget.historical_fit_records_reused: 6 outer component pairs plus 6 inner component pairs; all existing folds are repeated development data.

metrics: each primary window and each H12 window MAE
per-cycle paired delta MAE against LightGBM
signed error, EF0/EF1, target thirds, tails <=5/>=95, stream present/missing
paired absolute-error win/tie/loss rates and error correlation
promotion_guardrails: No promotion based on pooled MAE alone. Review H12, each window, equal-cycle error, EF/tail/stream groups, and paired per-cycle deltas. Validation has been adaptively reused and is not an untouched holdout.
next_stage_gate: No second-family model fit in this milestone. Parent reviews the paired blend results before any bounded follow-up model family.
